title: Thickness.
officialText:
The minimum thickness shall be as follows:
1. Tanks 36 inches (914 mm) in diameter or less shall have at least a 1/ -inch (6.4 mm) shell and 1/ -inch (6.4 mm) heads. 4 4
2. Tanks 37 inches (940 mm) to 72 inches (1829 mm) in diameter shall have at least a 1/ -inch (6.4 mm) shell and 5/ -inch (7.9 4 16
mm) heads.
3. Tanks 73 inches (1854 mm) to 120 inches (3048 mm) in diameter shall have at least a 5/ -inch (7.9 mm) shell and 3/ -inch 16 8 (9.5 mm) heads.
4. Tanks over 120 inches (3048 mm) in diameter shall be of at least 3/ -inch (9.5 mm) steel and shall be stiffened by angle rings 8 or equivalent members so as to retain their cylindrical form.
